messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent"
set: ["inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about all medical conditions", "inform healthcare provider about unexplained muscle aches or weakness", "inform healthcare provider about alcohol consumption more than 2 glasses daily", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "inform healthcare provider if 65 years of age or older", "tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking", "consult healthcare provider about best way to feed baby", "inform treating doctor about use", "inform doctor about alcohol consumption", "inform doctor about any changes", "ask healthcare provider about naloxone or nalmefene for opioid overdose", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
